deviations.what: review.views imports project.ghfdb.{forms,importers,report} instead of bare ghfdb.{forms,importers,report}, and [tool.deptry] known_first_party in pyproject.toml gained "project".
deviations.why: ghfdb.apps.GhfdbConfig registers under the dotted name "project.ghfdb" rather than bare "ghfdb" (unlike its sibling apps). A bare cross-app import re-executes ghfdb.models under a module identity the app registry never registered, raising RuntimeError at collection. project.ghfdb.* is the same path tests/test_ghfdb already uses, which left deptry flagging "project" as an undeclared dependency until known_first_party listed it.

deviations.what: T022 and T023 landed in one commit (3cc16e2) instead of two.
deviations.why: D6 makes the re-check-and-write and the double-submission guard the same mechanism (the assessment's state). Building T022's write path without the state guard would ship a confirm view that writes twice on a repeated POST for one commit's worth of work, which the story's own D5/D6 exist to rule out.
